note: What tools/history.py reads besides COP's own snapshots and ledger, and the periods it marks as not comparable. program_logs: the programs whose repositories keep a tic-history/1 log under history/log (only that folder is read; the other files in history/ are outside the feeds and are never read). Public repositories only: a program whose repository is private keeps its log private, and its items reach this set through COP's snapshots and ledger alone. breaks: a row that matches gets the note, and a note means the row is not comparable with rows outside its period.
